baptisms: 2nd & 4th saturdays of the month. confessions available on request before mass. go forth and teach all peoples. holy father make us one in christ, rooted in his love that unites and renews. ma y we all be united in mission, open to the holy spirit, courageous in bearing witness to the gospel. mary, christ’s first disciple, accompany our work of proclaiming the good news. make us instruments of peace, love and reconciliation. amen. ~ fr gerard. for emergencies only please ‘phone: during the week fr gerard finucane (087) 0554874 fr jerry keane (087) 2844649 fr pat (087) 2200114 from 1pm sunday –9am monday this weekend only fr pat (087) 2200114 november offerings for our beloved dead are due before the 1st of november. leaflets for the lists of your dead are available at the exits of the church. use the blue topped november offerings envelope in your box. masses as announced in parish newsletter during november will be offered for all whose names are on the parish november dead list.

come & join our parish choir! as we prepare for christmas & the very special celebration of 200 years of st marys church ballyheigue in 2027, we warmly invite new members to join our choir. all voices are welcome whether you have sung in a choir before or simply enjoy singing come along and help make these celebrations truly memorable through music & song! put your name down at the parish office, the sacristy or to any of the priests. free hse information evening : learn about fair deal, enduring power of attorney, sage advocacy, age friendly homes and more information stands from 7.30pm, talks begin at 8pm thursday, 22 october: meadowlands hotel, oakpark, tralee, v92 dc83 seanfhocail: is fear obair na caint. action speaks louder than words. 200th anniversary of st marys church ballyheigue. you are welcome to continue handing in your photos and mementos to the parish office. and we thank all of you who have contributed so far. any ideas on slogans or artwork can be submitted by email or at the office. we are particularly interested in any artists who may wish to submit an original artwork to be included in our forthcoming booklet. mile buiochas next meeting is 29th october 2026 at 7:45pm in the community centre

mission sunday world mission sunday 18th october 2026. this collection is vital to financing missionary work worldwide. the mission projects worldwide are coordinated by missio head office in rome, and the money goes direct from ireland to specific projects worldwide. give your donation in honour of irish missionaries, female and male, past and present. envelopes are available at both exits of the church, collection will be made after communion.

mass for the deceased of the past year, on thursday the 19th of november 7pm, we will remember in a special way all our faithful departed who have gone to their eternal rest during the last year. relatives and friends are warmly invited to attend this memorial mass during which a candle will be lit for each of the departed and their names will be remembered in prayer. you are welcome to then take the candle home. if you would like to remember someone who died outside the parish since last november, please drop their names in the letterbox of the presbytery.
